title: Dry and Weigh a Precipitate

nodes.title: Note the paper's mass
nodes.description: Note the dry filter paper's mass, which you weighed before filtering.

validation.label: Note the paper's mass was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Note the paper's mass and try again.

nodes.title: Zero the balance
nodes.description: With the pan empty and the draft-shield doors closed, check that the balance reads 0.000 g, and press TARE if it does not.

feedback.retry: Review Zero the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Put the watch glass on the balance
nodes.description: Put the clean, dry, labelled watch glass on the balance pan.

feedback.success: Put the watch glass on the balance complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put the watch glass on the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Read its mass
nodes.description: Read the balance and enter the empty watch glass's mass.

feedback.retry: Review Read its mass and try again.

nodes.title: Record the mass
nodes.description: Record the watch glass's mass in your notebook.

feedback.retry: Review Record the mass and try again.

nodes.title: Lift the paper onto the glass
nodes.description: Take the watch glass off the balance, then lift the paper with its solid out of the funnel and open it flat on the glass.

feedback.success: Lift the paper onto the glass complete.
feedback.retry: Review Lift the paper onto the glass and try again.

nodes.title: Pour away the filtrate
nodes.description: Pour the filtrate from the flask down the sink.

validation.label: Pour away the filtrate was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Pour away the filtrate and try again.

nodes.title: Set the oven
nodes.description: Turn the oven's control to between 110 and 120 °C, and enter the setting.

feedback.retry: Review Set the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Open the oven
nodes.description: Open the oven door.

feedback.retry: Review Open the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Put it in the oven
nodes.description: Put the watch glass with the paper and solid on the oven's shelf.

feedback.success: Put it in the oven complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put it in the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Dry it
nodes.description: Close the door and dry the solid for 10 to 15 minutes.

feedback.retry: Review Dry it and try again.

nodes.title: Open the oven
nodes.description: When the time is up, open the oven door.

feedback.retry: Review Open the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Take it out with tongs
nodes.description: Lift the warm watch glass out with the crucible tongs and set it on the heat-safe pad.

feedback.success: Take it out with tongs complete.
feedback.retry: Review Take it out with tongs and try again.

nodes.title: Close the oven
nodes.description: Close the oven door, so the oven keeps its temperature while you work.

feedback.retry: Review Close the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Break up the solid
nodes.description: Break the solid into small pieces with the metal scoop.

validation.label: Break up the solid was completed.

feedback.retry: Review Break up the solid and try again.

nodes.title: Open the oven
nodes.description: Open the oven door again.

feedback.retry: Review Open the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Put it back in the oven
nodes.description: With the tongs, put the watch glass back on the oven's shelf.

feedback.success: Put it back in the oven complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put it back in the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Dry it again
nodes.description: Close the door and dry for 5 more minutes.

feedback.retry: Review Dry it again and try again.

nodes.title: Open the oven
nodes.description: When the time is up, open the oven door.

feedback.retry: Review Open the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Take it out with tongs
nodes.description: Lift the watch glass out with the tongs and set it on the heat-safe pad.

feedback.success: Take it out with tongs complete.
feedback.retry: Review Take it out with tongs and try again.

nodes.title: Close the oven
nodes.description: Close the oven door.

feedback.retry: Review Close the oven and try again.

nodes.title: Let it cool
nodes.description: Leave it on the pad until it is cool enough to weigh.

feedback.retry: Review Let it cool and try again.

nodes.title: Put it on the balance
nodes.description: Put the cool watch glass, with the paper and dry solid, on the balance pan.

feedback.success: Put it on the balance complete.
feedback.retry: Review Put it on the balance and try again.

nodes.title: Read the combined mass
nodes.description: Read the balance and enter the combined mass.

validation.label: Read the combined mass was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Read the combined mass and try again.

nodes.title: Record the combined mass
nodes.description: Record the combined mass in your notebook.

validation.label: Record the combined mass was recorded.

feedback.retry: Review Record the combined mass and try again.

nodes.title: Work out the precipitate's mass
nodes.description: Subtract the watch glass's mass and the paper's mass from the combined mass.

validation.label: Work out the precipitate's mass was submitted.

feedback.success: Work out the precipitate's mass complete.
feedback.retry: Review Work out the precipitate's mass and try again.
